theory: The key is red. Every red thing is hot. Every hot thing is unsafe.
The rod is metal. Every metal thing is conductive. Everything conductive is not insulating.
Robin is a bird. Every bird can fly.
The token is blue. The token is round. Anything that is both blue and round is marked.
Worker 7 is permitted. Worker 7 is not blocked. Any permitted worker that is not blocked is schedulable.
Ada follows Bo. Bo follows Cy. If one person follows a second person and that second person follows a third, then the first can reach the third.
Node a is raw. Every raw node becomes parsed. Every parsed node becomes indexed. Every indexed node becomes searchable.
Every square is blue. Shape q is blue.
Every safe package is signed. Package p is not signed.
Item z is revoked. Every revoked item is not valid.
Mira owns file a. File a is sensitive. Anyone who owns something sensitive requires clearance.
Device x is online. Every online device is reachable. Device y is encrypted. Every encrypted device is protected.
